speaker: richard_quiney
text: Loving countryman? Richard Quiney. From the Bell in Carter Lane, these two days, and my boots not yet dry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard. Tell me the errand. I am not coming to Carter Lane before noon.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: The town's business. A brief for a collection through the shires, for the relief of Stratford after its fires. The certified schedules of loss are in my saddlebag, for the Lord Keeper's men.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And have the Lord Keeper's men seen them?

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I have waited on three gentlemen's secretaries, and I am promised a fourth. I look for the seal within ten days.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What do the schedules say the fire took?

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Two hundred houses, Will, taken one fire with another.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was on a ladder at that row in August. I counted about twenty.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: This year, twenty. I speak of the town's whole affliction.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then say twenty where you mean twenty. I will not quarrel with a schedule I have not seen.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I would have a word carried to my Lord Chamberlain.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My lord's gentleman laughs at players and would not weep for malt-barns. I will not carry him a fire to laugh at.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Then a supper, at the least. I've news of your house, and I'll make it better in the telling. A taste now: your father's barley is dry in the loft, ten quarters, and your boy sent the master a sheet of Latin with never a blot, which the master holds to be a miracle of the Church.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Send when your gentlemen have done with you. God keep you, Richard.
